description:
The memory-first coding agent

Letta Code is a memory-first coding harness, designed for long-lived agents that can learn from experience.
Instead of working in independent sessions, you work with a persisted agent whose memory is portable across models (Claude, GPT, Gemini, GLM, Kimi, and more).
What's Changed
- docs(skills): route agent renames through self-configuration by @sarahwooders in https://github.com/letta-ai/letta-code/pull/4135
- fix(permissions): treat trailing && or || as unparseable for allow-rule matching by @amelia-letta in https://github.com/letta-ai/letta-code/pull/4131
- feat(skills): add browser-use builtin by @letta-integration[bot] in https://github.com/letta-ai/letta-code/pull/4137
- feat(memory): export default constraints policy [LET-11631] by @letta-integration[bot] in https://github.com/letta-ai/letta-code/pull/4140
- refactor(agent): make subagent launches background-only by @letta-integration[bot] in https://github.com/letta-ai/letta-code/pull/4138
- fix(memory): count MemFS v2 core files in token estimates by @letta-integration[bot] in https://github.com/letta-ai/letta-code/pull/4147
- docs(agent): clarify default conversation resumes [LET-11772] by @amysguan in https://github.com/letta-ai/letta-code/pull/4149
- fix(subagents): honor model overrides for forks by @letta-integration[bot] in https://github.com/letta-ai/letta-code/pull/4154
